t2.thesis: ZETA has a four-for-four record of positive earnings-open reactions with consistent large beats and raised guidance, a recent pullback and a fresh Goldman upgrade, but a 15.6% implied move already prices in much of the upside.
reasons: Last 4 prints all rose at the next open (+6% to +13%), with EPS surprises of 39-58% and a 20-quarter beat-and-raise streak (I2, I4)
Goldman upgraded to Buy on Oct 16 citing upside to 2027 estimates, and the stock is about 9% off its 52-week high after a 1-month drop of 6%, so expectations are not stretched (I19, I2)
Implied move of 15.6% and ATM IV at 2.7x realized vol show the options market already prices a big move, which limits the edge (I1, I2)
Volume is low versus its 250-day average and short interest is 7%, so a beat could squeeze shorts; a weak AI-software tape (Oct 31 selloff) is a risk (I2, I11)
t2.deciding_variable: Whether Q4 revenue guidance and the raise to full-year 2026 and early 2027 outlook exceed the elevated buy-side whisper, given the AI-software sentiment backdrop.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit 0.542, software_internet cluster 0.541, AMC 0.538; used ~0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. The earnings date you mention (2026-11-09) is after today's date (2026-11-06), so that report hasn't happened yet and there's no stock reaction to report.
t2.moved_from_prior: Raised from 0.54 to 0.60: about +7 points for the consistent beat-and-raise history and upgrade, minus about 1 point because the options market already prices a large move.

theses.expected: Beat and raise again, stock opens up high single digits
theses.mechanism: Revenue above guidance midpoint, AI adoption metrics and Athena/OpenAI/Palantir momentum, with short covering
theses.wrong_if: Q4 guide implies deceleration or only an in-line raise

theses.expected: Beat but stock opens down on a sell-the-news reaction
theses.mechanism: A 15.6% implied move and the upgrade-driven run into the print leave a high bar; the beat is already priced
theses.wrong_if: The guide raise is much larger than the Street expects

theses.expected: Muted or flat open with a large intraday reversal
theses.mechanism: Macro and AI-spending anxiety offset solid results
theses.wrong_if: The open gaps decisively in either direction on the guide
